_comment: Changelog art. Sources live in site/art/, scripts/changelog-art.mjs writes AVIF, WebP, a thumbnail and a blurred placeholder for each into public/changelog-art/. A release with a strip gets it on the left page; every other release gets a one-panel SLIP card picked by the kind of change. Titles are optional; without one the first entry is the title. Overlay items (sfx, stamp) are drawn over the art as HTML, x and y in percent of the art.

1.12.3.alt: Manga strip: SLIP the receipt runs back and forth to the database, then makes one trip and finds the next tabs already waiting.

proud.alt: SLIP the receipt, fist up, proud.

sweating.alt: SLIP the receipt, running and sweating.

smug.alt: SLIP the receipt, arms crossed, smug.
